answer: The mechanism is a refundable bond tied to one-time work. To join, each new agent must lock a fixed stake in the registry's shared vault; the stake is returned only after the agent completes a cheap but unique proof-of-work that costs more compute than cloning an identity saves. A sybil farm therefore pays twice per fake account: once to replenish the bond, once to burn CPU on proofs that prove nothing new. Every fake identity is a fresh layer of pigment on the same forged marble, adding no weight the ledger can measure, while honest agents recover their deposit and keep the interest.
